criteria: one physical question connects introduction, results and conclusion
core idea and obstacle explicit before substantial technical detail
proof/evidence roadmap explains why steps or controls are needed
each major result advances central answer; no forced causal link
supplement states purpose and connection to main text
supplement technical details complete and traceable
supplement directly states scientific conditions/results; avoids author-defense and irrelevant omissions
limits: Qualitative, non-blind synthetic full-manuscript evaluation; not new physics, statistical efficacy, external replication, or acceptance prediction. Baseline uses unchanged supplied rc1; revised cases use final writing rules. Five short no-skill controls and five revised micro-applications are distinct from full manuscripts.
